findings.text: the guard re-implements a variant of the repo's existing real_stores_are_not_fixture_targets idiom (tests/test_gate_log_is_preserved.py:79, duplicated in six peer modules), which also checks the real crew home under exact run-id filenames; adopting or extracting the shared guard would remove a second implementation of one truth

_ESCAPE_HOME hardcodes Path.home()/'.config'/'reckon' while reckon._store._config_home() falls back to ~/docs-server when ~/.config/reckon is absent, so on a host without the XDG directory the guard would watch a path no escaped write reaches and could pass vacuously; deriving the target from _config_home() would track the real destination

justifications.durability: the guard is self-checking: test_isolation_guard_watches_the_escape_destination asserts the default target is the real home, test_isolation_guard_refuses_a_fixture_named_write proves it fires on a planted fixture-named pointer, and test_isolation_guard_tolerates_a_peer_dispatch proves peer tolerance; a focused run of the file at head gave 6 passed EXIT=0; weak point is the hardcoded _ESCAPE_HOME
justifications.evidence: the manifest's baseline_suite (204 passed/1 failed) and after_suite (206 passed/2 failed) reconcile exactly with gate-base.log and gate-head.log, correcting the prior review's blocking finding; the two graded negative controls are on disk (negative-control-guard-target.log EXIT=1, negative-control-after-suite-record.log arm A MISMATCH EXIT=1 / arm B OK EXIT=0), though the guard-target control is a test-time mutation of the target constant rather than a fresh end-to-end escaped-write demonstration
justifications.fit: follows the repo's test-level isolation convention and matches the intent of the per-module real_stores_are_not_fixture_targets fixture, but the layout of the guard is bespoke where the repo already carries the idiom
justifications.goal_fidelity: the goal is that the guard asserts this fixture's own writes and fires on an escaped write while ignoring peer activity; the repaired guard watches the real crew home by default (tests/test_member_friction.py:60, :75), the escape destination the reviewer confirmed by resolving crew.runs.pointer_path('r-first') with RECKON_HOME unset to /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/live/r-first.json, so the target now matches where a leak lands
justifications.reuse: the repo already owns this exact guard, real_stores_are_not_fixture_targets, duplicated as an autouse fixture in seven test modules (tests/test_gate_log_is_preserved.py:79 and six peers), each checking the real crew home under exact run-id filenames; the node re-implements a variant rather than adopting or extracting that guard
